name: Paneer Tikka Masala
instructions: Cut paneer, onion, and capsicum into cubes.
Marinate paneer in yogurt and spices for 15 minutes.
Pan-sear the paneer cubes until lightly golden; set aside.
Saute onion and ginger garlic paste until translucent.
Add pureed tomato and cook until the oil separates.
Stir in garam masala and cream, then add the paneer and capsicum.
Simmer for 5 minutes and serve hot with naan or rice.

name: Kadai Paneer
instructions: Dry roast and coarsely grind the kadai masala spices.
Saute onion until golden, then add ginger garlic paste.
Add chopped tomato and cook until soft.
Stir in the ground spice mix and a splash of water.
Add capsicum and paneer cubes, tossing gently.
Cook for 5-6 minutes and garnish with fresh coriander.

name: Paneer Bhurji
instructions: Crumble the paneer with your hands or a fork.
Heat oil and saute onion and green chili until soft.
Add turmeric and chopped tomato; cook until mushy.
Fold in the crumbled paneer and cook for 3-4 minutes.
Season with salt and serve with paratha or toast.

name: Classic Margherita Pizza
instructions: Preheat the oven to its highest setting with a pizza stone if available.
Roll out the dough into a thin round base.
Spread a simple crushed-tomato sauce over the base.
Tear the mozzarella and scatter it evenly.
Bake for 8-10 minutes until the crust is charred in spots.
Top with fresh basil and a drizzle of olive oil before serving.

name: Creamy Tomato Pasta
instructions: Boil the pasta in salted water until al dente; reserve some pasta water.
Saute garlic and onion in olive oil until fragrant.
Add chopped tomato and simmer into a chunky sauce.
Stir in cream and simmer for 3-4 minutes.
Toss the drained pasta into the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed.
Finish with black pepper and grated cheese.

name: Vegetable Hakka Noodles
instructions: Boil noodles until just tender, then rinse in cold water and toss with oil.
Heat a wok over high heat and add a splash of oil.
Stir-fry carrot, capsicum, and cabbage for 2-3 minutes, keeping them crisp.
Add the noodles, soy sauce, and a splash of vinegar.
Toss everything together over high heat for 2 minutes.
Garnish with spring onion and serve immediately.

name: Chicken Manchurian
instructions: Coat chicken pieces in cornstarch and shallow fry until crisp; set aside.
Stir-fry garlic, onion, and capsicum in a hot wok.
Add soy sauce and a cornstarch slurry to form a glossy sauce.
Toss the fried chicken back in and coat evenly.
Simmer for 2-3 minutes until the sauce thickens.
Garnish with spring onion and serve with fried rice.

name: Loaded Bean Burrito Bowl
instructions: Cook the rice and set aside.
Simmer black beans with cumin, chili powder, and a pinch of salt.
Dice tomato and onion for a quick fresh salsa; squeeze in lime juice.
Warm the corn in a dry pan until lightly charred.
Assemble bowls with rice, beans, salsa, and corn.
Top with avocado or cilantro if available.

name: Chicken Fajita Tacos
instructions: Slice chicken and vegetables into thin strips.
Marinate chicken with lime juice, cumin, and chili powder.
Sear chicken in a hot pan until browned and cooked through.
Stir-fry the onion and capsicum until slightly charred.
Combine chicken and vegetables, then warm the tortillas.
Assemble tacos with the filling and desired toppings.

name: Classic American Pancakes
instructions: Whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and a pinch of salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk milk, egg, and melted butter.
Combine wet and dry ingredients until just mixed (a few lumps are fine).
Pour small circles of batter onto a hot, lightly greased pan.
Flip once bubbles form on the surface and cook until golden.
Serve stacked with syrup and extra butter.

name: BBQ Chicken Burger
instructions: Pound the chicken breast to an even thickness and season well.
Grill or pan-sear the chicken until fully cooked, basting with BBQ sauce.
Caramelize sliced onion in a little butter.
Toast the burger buns lightly.
Layer chicken, cheese, and caramelized onion on the bun.
Finish with extra BBQ sauce and serve with fries.

name: Mediterranean Chickpea Salad
instructions: Drain and rinse the chickpeas.
Dice tomato, cucumber, and onion into small pieces.
Combine chickpeas and vegetables in a large bowl.
Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and oregano for the dressing.
Toss the salad with the dressing.
Chill for 10 minutes before serving for best flavor.

name: Grilled Salmon with Lemon
instructions: Marinate the salmon in olive oil, lemon juice, and crushed garlic.
Preheat a grill pan over medium-high heat.
Grill the salmon skin-side down for 4-5 minutes, then flip.
Cook asparagus alongside until tender-crisp.
Cook the salmon until it flakes easily, about 3-4 more minutes.
Serve with a fresh lemon wedge and the grilled asparagus.

name: Chicken Katsu Curry
instructions: Bread the chicken cutlets: flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs.
Shallow fry the cutlets until golden and crisp; slice into strips.
Saute onion and simmer with water and curry roux cubes until thickened.
Cook the rice separately.
Plate rice with curry sauce and top with the katsu chicken.
Garnish with pickled ginger if available.

name: Vegetable Sushi Rolls
instructions: Cook sushi rice and season with rice vinegar, sugar, and salt.
Cut cucumber, carrot, and avocado into thin matchsticks.
Lay nori on a bamboo mat and spread a thin layer of rice.
Arrange vegetable strips along one edge.
Roll tightly using the mat, sealing the edge with water.
Slice into bite-sized pieces with a sharp, wet knife.

name: Thai Green Curry
instructions: Fry the green curry paste in a splash of coconut milk until fragrant.
Add the chicken and cook until sealed on all sides.
Pour in the remaining coconut milk and bring to a gentle simmer.
Add capsicum and cook until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in fresh basil leaves just before serving.
Serve over steamed jasmine rice.

name: Thai Pad See Ew
instructions: Soak the rice noodles until pliable.
Scramble the eggs in a hot wok and set aside.
Stir-fry garlic and broccoli until bright green.
Add the noodles and soy sauce, tossing constantly to prevent sticking.
Fold the scrambled egg back in.
Serve immediately with a wedge of lime.

name: Quick Vegetable Fried Rice
instructions: Use day-old rice for the best texture.
Scramble the egg in a hot wok and set aside.
Stir-fry diced onion and carrot until softened.
Add the rice, breaking up clumps, and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Add soy sauce and the scrambled egg, tossing to combine.
Serve hot, garnished with spring onion.

name: Chocolate Lava Cake
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220C (425F) and grease two ramekins.
Melt chocolate and butter together until smooth.
Whisk in the eggs and sugar until pale and slightly thickened.
Fold in the flour until just combined.
Divide between the ramekins and bake for 10-12 minutes until the edges are set but the center still jiggles slightly.
Let rest 1 minute, then invert onto plates and serve immediately.

name: Mango Sticky Rice
instructions: Soak glutinous rice for at least 2 hours, then steam until tender.
Warm the coconut milk with sugar and a pinch of salt until dissolved.
Fold most of the sweetened coconut milk into the warm rice.
Let the rice absorb the liquid for 10-15 minutes.
Slice the mango and arrange beside the rice.
Drizzle the remaining coconut milk over the top before serving.
